name: lid
title: The lid: the body's outline as a plate, with snap pins for its sockets
orientation: Flat on the bed, pins up. Drawn mirrored, so that turned over onto the body its pins meet the sockets.

length.rule: The pins' length: the sockets' depth

lip.rule: The barb past the pin: what the sockets' cavities allow for

slot.rule: The split down each pin from its tip: through the barb and most of the shaft, leaving the foot whole

window.rule: A thumb window over the grip pocket, to see the bow

foot.rule: The pins' feet, as the generator draws them: sunk into the plate, so the shafts start at its face
